scope: the v0.11 surface: 25 changed/added src files (1526 insertions) against brain/architecture/standards.md, the module graph, and the contract

findings.summary: cursor.ts imported pathHits from claude-code.ts - the only cross-adapter dependency in the tree. A sibling adapter reaching into another adapter's internals couples R3a to R3c: changing one host's helper silently alters another host's behavior, and it contradicts the repo's own rule that feature code lands per-host (standards.md: 'New feature code lands by feature (src/adapters/<host>.ts), not by layer').

The three adapters duplicate ~150 lines of near-identical helpers (isPlain, sameJson, clone, protectedPaths, detectIndent, serialize, guardTargets, readSettings, restore, verifyWrite). Each adapter is individually correct and pinned by its own suite, so this is not a behavior defect; it is a maintenance hazard where a fix applied to one adapter's copy may be missed in the others.

A cursor adapter edge: a sessionStart entry that is a plain string (rather than an object with `command`) is not scanned as aegis-shaped, so a hand-written string entry would be preserved as foreign content instead of refusing. The documented Cursor schema uses objects with `command`, and the adapter never touches foreign content, so the risk is a lingering stale hook rather than corruption.
